description:
InvestMenter Real Estate LLC presents this two-bedroom apartment in Clearpoint, nestled in Mina Rashid, also known as Rashid Yachts & Marina, where lifestyle meets legacy.

ClearPoint by Emaar at Rashid Yachts & Marina presents a seamless blend of luxury and comfort, featuring breathtaking marina views, sophisticated interiors, and exceptional amenities — all within a peaceful, beautifully landscaped waterfront setting.

Key Features:
2 Bedrooms
1368 sq. ft.
Handover Q3 2027
Multiple options available

First-class amenities:
Canal Pool
Vibrant children's park
State-of-the-art gym
Daycare center
Swimming Pool
Covered Parking

Discover the pinnacle of coastal luxury at Rashid Yachts & Marina — an architectural icon redefining waterfront living. Set along Dubai’s Arabian Gulf shoreline, this exclusive yacht resort blends elegance, privacy, and leisure, offering stunning views and a lifestyle beyond compare.
